Metadata.Goal: Add idiomatic Kon declaration syntax for the existing schema/ontology type-system kernel.
Metadata.Description: Expose branded scalars, schema mixins, schema types, relations, and aliases through Kon source declarations that lower to TypeSystem kernel APIs.

TaskSpace.name: add-kon-schema-ontology-syntax
TaskSpace.Description: Add Kon declaration syntax for schema/ontology kernel APIs.

TaskGroup.name: Syntax design and binder routing
TaskGroup.Description: Finalize declaration forms and add binder branches.

Task.name: Add top-level declaration routing
Task.Description: Add scalar, mixin, schema, relation, and top-level attr declaration cases to KonTypeBinder, including `:{ alias_of = ... }` alias forms.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Unsupported declaration diagnostics remain stable for truly unsupported top-level forms.

Task.name: Implement declaration lowering
Task.Description: Lower new Kon forms to existing TypeSystem schema/ontology APIs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: `(attr #host :{ alias_of = Server.hostname })` maps host to canonical attribute hostname in Server scope.

TaskGroup.name: Diagnostics and tests
TaskGroup.Description: Add source-level tests and diagnostics for malformed declarations.

Task.name: Add positive Kon syntax tests
Task.Description: Cover scalar, mixin, schema, relation, and same-level `:{ alias_of = ... }` aliases from Kon source.

Task.name: Add negative diagnostics tests
Task.Description: Cover unknown schema targets, alias cycles, malformed alias target, and duplicate declarations.

TaskGroup.name: Verification and docs handoff
TaskGroup.Description: Run targeted verification and update examples if needed.

Task.name: Run typecheck and targeted tests
Task.Description: Run `bun run typecheck` and schema/ontology syntax tests.

Task.name: Record user-facing syntax examples
Task.Description: Ensure examples show same-level `:{ alias_of = ... }` syntax and explicitly reject nested alias forms.
